snippet.title: Danger Sticks - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
!! WISHLIST NOW !!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4073490/Danger_Sticks
!! WISHLIST NOW !!

Danger Sticks is a ruthless, hyper-fast first-person stickman shooter that channels the energy of 2000s flash-era fight animations. You’re a nimble silhouette tearing through blocky, prototype-style recreations of real-world locations. Activate Nostalgia to trigger true bullet time, line up crisp headshots, and route through fire with a wide arsenal. Short, handcrafted encounters, instant restarts, and tight scoring create a learn-die-perfect loop built for mastery.

Each level is a compact combat puzzle. Read the space at a glance, prioritize targets, and commit. Pop Nostalgia to slow the storm for a heartbeat then thread shots, swap weapons, reposition and then let the world snap back and finish the room before your window closes. Speed, accuracy, and clean movement are everything; hesitation isn’t.

Key Features
- True bullet time on demand: Use Nostalgia to slow the world and sculpt precise, multi-target headshot chains.
- First-person, room-clearing combat: Hand-tuned arenas inspired by real places, presented with a clean, block-out “prototype” vibe for instant readability.
- Wide, punchy arsenal: Pistols, SMGs, shotguns, rifles, and more. Quick swapping and smart ammo use reward planning under pressure.
- Instant restarts: Fail fast, reset faster, and chase a cleaner line without downtime.
- Tight scoring for mastery: Ranks that emphasize speed, accuracy, headshot ratio, and efficient routes.
- Signature stickman style: Minimal silhouettes, exaggerated impacts, bold VFX, and crunchy audiovisual feedback that sells every hit.

Plan. Pop Nostalgia. Pounce. Then do it cleaner, faster, sharper.
